guard: with no explicit target and no selection, a terminal chooses between running spaces for one run and the selection stays; a script, --json and --no-input refuse an ambiguous target with the remedy apart from the message; a manifest's declared space is the target of up -f and spawn -f, and another --space is refused before anything is written
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/target-resolution.smoke.ts
why: Each mutation removes one condition the chooser checks before it asks, one way the answer becomes the run's target, one place a manifest's space is enforced, or one place a refusal keeps its remedy apart. The suite drives the binary from source over built packages, so each mutation rebuilds them and the restore rebuilds them back.
